pages.task: Subject: "Root Smash": a giant fist made of tangled thick mossy oak roots (bark #6b4423/#8c5a2b, moss, amber glints) smashing DOWN from above onto ONE cell. Frame 1: the root fist enters at the top of the cell, knuckles down, with motion streaks. Frames 2-3: it plunges fast toward the ground, trailing leaves. Frame 4: impact at the ground in the lower middle: bright white-gold flash, shock ring, soil and splinters burst. Frame 5: fist pressing into the soil, cracks radiate outward, dust cloud, flying clods. Frame 6: fist starts to lift, roots uncurl. Frames 7-8: fist sinks back/fades, cracks, dust and falling leaves fade; frame 8 faint remnant. Impact point stays the same from frame 4 on.
pages.checkRules:
- Exactly 2:1, 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 equal cells; NO grid lines/borders/numbers/text.
- Background really transparent (no black, no magenta residue, no dark halo, no black rectangle); corners and cell borders transparent.
- Every frame fully inside its cell with transparent margin; no content crossing cell borders; no empty frame.
- Frames form one smooth animation: same centre/size logic between neighbours, no sudden jump, frame 1 visible, frame 8 fading remnant.
- One bold readable subject per frame, hand-painted medieval style, no neon/sci-fi/purple/noise, no characters, no text.
- Reads as a big fist of roots slamming down from above with clear impact at frame 4, dust/cracks after, then withdrawing; no body or arm attached, no character.
- Impact point constant from frame 4; fist bold and readable.
